title: Getting-started guides for each way of running Kanbus
description: Rework the getting-started documentation around three ways of running Kanbus: local files in git, files in the cloud (git-synced cloud console with MQTT realtime), and the S3 plus DynamoDB writable API. Each guide gives tested step-by-step setup. Fix inaccuracies found while testing (missing search command, config.yaml location) and address recurring setup confusion: gitignore, committing board state, project keys, console ports.
